marked.s: Then ask whether your judgment has gotten better or you keep falling for the same stuff, and what your friends or exes would say.
marked.difference: way 4: "the same stuff" is vague about what repeats; way 1: two questions (judgment/same stuff, and friends or exes) packed into one sentence, where he would give each its own clause

marked.s: Then ask whether your judgment has gotten better or you keep falling for the same stuff, and what your friends or exes would say.
marked.found: MISREAD (mild): "ask ... your judgment" mixes an instruction to the reader with "your" meaning the other person, so it can read as the reader asking about their own judgment
